name: Mother Rudd House Museum open hours
location: Mother Rudd House, 4690 Old Grand Avenue, Gurnee
raw: Warren Township Historical Society at the Mother Rudd House: 4690 Old Grand Avenue, Gurnee. Admission is free. Donations appreciated. Open Tuesdays 9:30am - 11:00 am and by appointment.
notes: Tuesdays; also open by appointment; scout/school groups can be accommodated
